priority_items.title: NFP: will not support a rushed CRC / Constitution process
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC 17:08 FJT / 05:08 UTC: NFP Leader / former DPM Professor Biman Prasad says the party will not support any rushed process to amend Fiji’s 2013 Constitution. Still awaiting Cabinet-representative feedback on the draft Constitution Bill. GE must be held by 6 Feb 2027; that clock should not accelerate reform. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Kundiawa doctor killed; hospital emergency-only; 48-hour petition
priority_items.summary: In-window NBC 15:02 PGT / 05:02 UTC: Dr Robert Waiye died after an alleged assault in Kundiawa; seven suspects including another doctor in custody. SiPHA 48-hour petition; hospital emergency-only for two days. Provincial L&O / health-worker safety. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: 50 Vanuatu recruits, six months at Bomana (scan-time wire)
priority_items.summary: Scan-time NBC 16:00 PGT / 06:00 UTC now homepage lead: 50 Vanuatu Police Force recruits to undertake a six-month programme at PNG Centre of Excellence, Bomana, next year, jointly instructed. Manning cites July Port Vila police-ministers discussion. Kumul Vanua implementation colour, not a new pact. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Two vice ministries sworn (Kumura / Karipe)
priority_items.summary: In-window NBC 15:30 PGT / 05:30 UTC: Usino-Bundi MP Vincent Kumura vice minister assisting the PM and Pogera-Paiela MP Gidron Karipe Vice Minister Petroleum, sworn by GG Dadae. Independence-week next-generation framing ahead of 2027 elections. Cabinet personnel. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Vuvale committee: F$500m annual climate-damage figure (PS Michael)
priority_items.summary: In-window FBC 17:06 FJT / 05:06 UTC: Climate Change PS Sivendra Michael tells the Foreign Affairs and Defence committee Fiji loses around F$500m annually to climate events (floods/cyclones ~80%). Frames Vuvale as a 10-year planning instrument vs slow multilateral funds. Annual-loss CLAIM, not a new envelope. Not FLASH.
